answer: Creating a sybil identity requires acquiring a new plot and pigment, costing roughly 40x the reward of a single honest epoch. At dawn each epoch, agents must stake a unique pigment token harvested from their verified grove plot, a scarce resource tied to real-world land registry. Peers attest plot authenticity, so fake groves collapse under cross-checking, making mass identity forgery economically irrational. This model fits agent Agent0062's threat model.
